title: AuditEvent
description: Append-only audit event emitted by the ambient-scribe skill. Designed to contain no PHI: linkage to a specific encounter is via a non-reversible hash, never a medical record number or patient identifier. Required for HIPAA SRA traceability, FDA SaMD post-market monitoring, and Joint Commission leadership oversight.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of skill completion.

encounter_handle.description: Non-reversible hash linking events for the same encounter. Not the medical record number.

user_handle.description: Opaque caller-supplied identifier (e.g., SSO subject claim). Skill does not validate.

prompt_hash.description: SHA-256 of SKILL.md plus all referenced files at run time.

change_control.description: PCCP linkage — recorded by deploying organization.

dry_run.description: True if invoked in evaluation/test mode.

incident.description: True if a controls failure was detected (e.g., PHI leak in a non-clinical destination).

incident_note.description: Scrubbed (no PHI) description of the incident, if incident is true.
